title: Recover before restarting

nodes.label: Suspend and revoke
nodes.detail: Stop affected execution and remove access.

nodes.label: Preserve evidence
nodes.detail: Save action traces, versions and changed state.

nodes.label: Restore and verify
nodes.detail: Recover the product and verify the correction.

nodes.label: Authorize restart
nodes.detail: The responsible owner decides when the workflow may resume.

textEquivalent: Suspend the affected workflow and revoke access. Preserve action traces, versions and changed state. Restore the product and verify the correction. The responsible owner authorizes a restart only after both checks.
